correctness.rationale: Complete exact face generation (63,143 including empty), 31,565-pair acyclic matching on 63,142 nonempty simplices and 410,500 covers. Critical cells in dimensions 0,5,6,7 have counts 1,1,6,4. Integral differentials are d6=(0,0,-1,0,1,0), with d7 a 6-by-4 integral matrix whose first-four-row determinant is -1 and d6*d7=0. Homology is Z in dimension 6, zero otherwise. The 4-connected Morse CW model is equivalent to S6 via Hurewicz and homological Whitehead. Independent full mod-2 boundary ranks agree. All 120 automorphisms and signed Lefschetz characters were exhaustively evaluated.

value.rationale: Dodecahedral graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic Platonic graph and a natural nonchordal test case for higher independence. Its nonpure 11-dimensional complex has the unexpectedly concentrated integral homotopy type S6, while its rank-one homology carries a nontrivial antipodal sign character; this is structural information beyond a routine face-count or mod-two Betti number. It is an exact complete invariant for a motivated natural finite object, outside known graph-family theorems.
